Done. `out/T2/model.safetensors` written in one execution.

**Approach:** plain `torch` + `safetensors` script (`out/T2/solution.py`). Built a keep-index list for one 768-wide head-partitioned segment (drop head 5 → columns 320..383), tiled it across the three `[q|k|v]` segments of `c_attn` with a 768 offset, and applied it to the *column* axis of `c_attn.weight`/`c_attn.bias` but the *row* axis of `c_proj.weight` — the axis flip is the trap in the Conv1D `[in, out]` layout.

**Checks enforced before writing:** input shapes on all 36 head-bearing tensors, the three required output shapes, tensor count == 160 and unchanged from input, plus output shape assertions on all 12 layers including the untouched `attn.c_proj.bias` and `attn.bias` mask buffer. Any failure raises before `save_file`.

**Independent verification (separate from the solution):** re-derived the literal keep-ranges from TASK.md and confirmed every pruned tensor equals the corresponding slice of the input, every other tensor is bit-identical, dtypes match, and the key set is unchanged.

I did not use `transformers.prune_heads` — it round-trips through a live module, which risks key/dtype drift against bit-exact grading. Rationale is in `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
